desc:
Welcome to Miss Kitty... 

In this mysterious house🏠, your goal is to find hidden keys🗝️, unlock doors🚪, and make your escape🏃. But it isn't as easy as it seems... Something has entered your home, something big... stalking you through the darkness.👁️🐾🌑 There is no time to waste! You must find a way out! 🗝️🐈‍⬛

📌Like the game❤️ for more updates!👍

This game is greatly inspired by: Teddy (GnomeCode) and Piggy
Note: Full Credits to Gnomecode for the main scripting part of the game!
